items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: Freddie Kepard, used to follow all them fellas.

ctx.x: Did you follow those bands when you were a kid like all the other bands?
Oh yeah, I used to follow Manuel Perez and Joe Oliver and all those fellas. Freddie Kepard, used to follow all them fellas.
Who was your favorite trumpet player in those days? Did you have a favorite? Yeah, I did.

items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: Old man Chalineese is what I want to call the name that night.

ctx.x: Excuse me for interrupting, but I wanted to know just where you were born, too.

Yeah. I was born in Corrine. That's in Seminard Paris. And we used to go down to Merrillville, you know, they had a big store down and all the bars would be on the front gallery, you know. And he'd have the guitar playing it, you know, and we'd be dancing and going on like that. So he stayed there a while and he went and Freddie Kepard was going with his sister, you know, Sister Noon, and he advised him to put the banjo, the guitar down, and learn clarinet. So he did. Old man Chalineese is what I want to call the…
I called Chalineese the other night.
